name: Ma-pó

name: Tuā-uī-ông

flaw: Greedy digger — hazards fire TWICE on his Visit (he digs so greedily the island bites back double).

art_note: A grinning competitive eater mid-bite, table piled with empty bowls
blurb: A competitive eater with a bottomless appetite and no brakes — he'll clear the whole table, hazards be damned.

name: Bāng-âng

flaw: Goes last — 網紅 takes the LAST seat in turn order each round (an ordering, not a lost turn).

blurb: A food blogger who genuinely, ridiculously loves the island — forever framing the perfect bowl for the feed.
